talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.tyrant: Halt. Strangers pay the king's toll to walk his streets. %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.noble: Good day. There's a small toll for the upkeep of the roads, %s, if you can spare it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.warlord: City toll: %s. It pays for the walls you're standing behind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.paranoid: Toll. %s. And your name, and where you've come from.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reveler: A coin for the king's feast! %s, and you're welcome at the table.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.plain: There's a toll for using our road. %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.tyrant.more: %s, into the king's coffers. Strangers who don't pay don't walk free.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.noble.more: %s for the roads and the bridges. Nobody's turned away for being poor, mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.warlord.more: %s for the garrison. Walls don't build themselves, and soldiers don't eat stone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.paranoid.more: %s. Everyone pays. Everyone is written down. That's how we keep him safe.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reveler.more: %s, and there's cake and ale for everyone tonight. The king insists!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.plain.more: %s to keep the road mended. It's the same for everyone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.purist: Your kind pays to walk these streets. %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.purist_kin: Kinsman! The toll's %1$s for our own. Next to nothing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.purist.more: %1$s. %3$s folk walk free. %2$s folk pay. That's how it is here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.purist_kin.more: %1$s, for the walls that keep our blood safe. Outsiders pay four times that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.paid.tyra: Into the king's coffers. You may pass.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.paid.para: Paid. Your name's been noted. Go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.paid.reve: To the feast! Here, have something sweet for your trouble!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.paid.puri: Paid. Now keep to the side of the street.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggled.w: Hmph. %s, and you owe me a drink.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggled.p: %s. Fine. But I've written it down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggled.r: Ha! You drive a hard bargain! %s it is!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggled.p: %s, then. Just this once. Don't make a habit of bargaining with your betters.
%s it is. Can't squeeze our own.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggle_fa: Haggle? With the king's men? I'll take it all, and a slap for asking.
I'm afraid the toll is the toll. I'm sorry.
The toll's the toll, soldier. Pay it or don't.
Bargaining. Exactly what a spy would do.
No, no, full price! It's for the cake!
Haggling? With me? Know your place.
It's one silver, brother. Even for us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.refuse.ty: Then you'll pay in blood. Guards!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.refuse.no: Very well. The road is free to those who can't pay.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.refuse.wa: Cheapskate. Don't expect help from the garrison.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.refuse.pa: Refused. We'll be watching you very closely.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.refuse.pu: Then crawl back to wherever your kind comes from.
Hm. Not like our blood to be tight-fisted. Go on, then.

talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reveler.her: A coin for the queen's feast! %s, and you're welcome at the table.
